scope: Second improvement pass over the same ten tar/gem archives

changes.observation: A field named twoFactor does not distinguish a reusable seed from a one-time code.
changes.fix: Replace the raw-text TOTP-secret matcher with a parsed body.twoFactor binding. Exclude comments, quoted examples and comparisons. Describe the surrounding POST as near password and 2FA fields; label the off-provider relay as an inference.

changes.observation: A 0700 directory-creation option was reported under file executability. Importing writeFile and having a nearby mode token did not prove an executable file write.
changes.fix: Remove the unbound mode/co-occurrence rules. Add call-bound mkdir permission evidence and strengthen canonical writeFile/writeFileSync permission matching. Preserve write-stream behavior with a separate call-bound stream matcher, including constructor syntax.

changes.observation: Literal executable creation modes may use bare calls, quoted keys, decimal/hex 0700 or set-ID octal bits.
changes.fix: Cover those forms while requiring the mode in the correct call argument. Distinguish private writes, nested unrelated options, comments and neighboring directory modes.

changes.observation: has-bin-field was a pure alias whose description claimed that the CLI file existed. Bin-map counts also lived under published-file counts.
changes.fix: Consolidate callers on bin-field-declared and describe a declaration only. Move bin-entry counts to package entrypoint/command metadata, preserving their matchers and updating the reverse-shell consumer.

references: Exact callers updated; retired IDs have no YAML references. No ancestor selectors depended on the moved bin-count leaves. A write/extraction consumer now uses the canonical call-bound file-permission observation.

verification.attack_preservation: A concealed passworded-archive PE loader still matches node-passworded-archive-pe-dropper at hostile. A version with only unrelated directory executable mode cannot satisfy that particular executable-write leg.
